generationMethod: authored from the recorded e2e/design-system/responsive.spec.ts run, its six retained screenshots and test-results/design-system/artifacts/.last-run.json; no responsive test was re-run for this dataset
scope: Responsive behaviour of the internal MC-17 catalogue at six widths and 200% text scaling: page overflow, table scroll regions, clipping, control overlap, the found-and-fixed grid defect, and the limits of the evidence.

recordedRun.reporterCaveat: test-results/design-system/results.json retains 28 skipped entries with zero results from the same run; it is a reporter artifact. The completion record is .last-run.json plus the generated screenshots and axe summary.

widths.purpose: WCAG 1.4.10 reflow floor and narrowest supported phone; original overflow defect width
assertions: every table inside a labelled focusable scrollable region
no clipped or overlapping controls at 200% text

widths.purpose: Common small-Android width; confirms 320-only fixes are not width-hardcoded
Reference modern phone width (also the performance profile width)
Tablet / two-column boundary; definition and specification layouts collapse
Navigation breakpoint: toggle hidden, horizontal list visible
Desktop reference width also used by the visual baselines

textScaling.method: inject html { font-size: 200% !important; } at each width, wait two frames, remove in finally
assertions: every visible button/link stays within the viewport
no control clips its own content in either axis
no sibling controls overlap by more than 1px in both axes
textScaling.caveat: Assertion-level evidence only; no 200% screenshot and no manual browser-zoom review.

defect.cause: Implicit/auto grid tracks sized to the max-content width of a long child, widening the grid instead of wrapping
fix: overflow-wrap: break-word/anywhere for long unbreakable words
defect.currentVerification: responsive.spec.ts asserts no overflow at all six widths, with and without 200% text scaling; the six screenshots exist
defect.provenance: The 876px magnitude and max-content diagnosis are from the Lead's milestone defect record. The pre-fix tree is not reconstructable here without Git and source changes, so the before-state is recorded, not re-executed; the after-state is verified by the committed assertion.

screenshotInventory.note: Written only after the assertions for that width pass, because the screenshot call follows them in the loop.

knownLimitations: Chromium/Windows only; Firefox, WebKit, macOS, Linux, real phones and high-DPI hardware are not covered.
The responsive test exercises the internal catalogue, not every future consumer composition.
The 200% check is a scripted font-size override, not a manual browser-zoom or assistive-technology review.
No cross-browser or real-device claim is made.
The 876px before-state is a Lead-recorded value and was not reproduced by this documentation task.
The JSON reporter file does not contain per-test results; the completion status comes from .last-run.json and the retained screenshots.
notClaimed: No visual approval or brand adoption.
